text: Airline checkout screen automatically pre-selected Rs 399 accidental flight insurance and Rs 150 carbon offset donation into total basket.
Hotel booking page showing blinking red countdown: '10:00 minutes remaining before room is released! 4 other people are looking right now!'
Shopping app modal popup: Accept 10% coupon or click tiny gray text saying 'No thanks, I prefer paying full price and wasting money'.
Fitness app free 7-day trial requires entering credit card and automatically signs up for Rs 4,999 annual billing with no online cancel button.
Product listed as Rs 499 on catalog page, but checkout adds mandatory Rs 150 convenience fee, Rs 80 packing fee, and Rs 120 handling charge.
News website repeatedly interrupts reading every 15 seconds with fullscreen popups demanding 'Enable Push Notifications' with no 'Never' option.
Promotional email contains large green 'Download Invoice' button that redirects to an affiliate online gambling registration page.
To unsubscribe from marketing emails, user must call an international phone number between 2 AM and 4 AM on weekdays.
Standard clean checkout page with item price Rs 500, tax Rs 90, shipping Rs 50 clearly shown before clicking proceed. No pre-ticked add-ons.
Transparent software subscription showing Monthly (Rs 299/mo) and Annual (Rs 2,400/yr) with 1-click 'Cancel Subscription' link in Account Settings.
